title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
title_zh: KineWorld: 行动诱导的运输场用于具身世界建模

paragraphs.en: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose K i n e W o rld , a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA–AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0 . KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 具身世界模型在执行候选动作之前，会预测其视觉后果。 然而，现有的以动作为条件的世界模型通常采用均匀加权的视觉生成目标，而这些目标可能与具身预测的需求不一致。 即使有明确的运动条件约束，这些目标仍可能低估那些对交互至关重要的空间稀疏变化。 我们提出了 K i n e W o rld——一个具备运输感知的世界建模框架，它将机器人运动学从运动条件约束扩展到生成监督的空间分配。 运动学运输提升（KTL）通过指令驱动的机器人运动，构建出源自渲染器且与相机对齐的运输场。 运输感知世界扩散（TAWD）在视频潜在格子上校准其运动支持，并通过均匀分布与运输导向分布的归一化混合，重新加权未来 RGB 流匹配。 我们使用来自 RoboTwin 2.0 的 ALOHA–AgileX 双手操作数据来训练 KineWorld。 KineWorld 在单视角评估中取得了 68.95 的 EWMScore-P，在多视角评估中获得了 54.82 的 TWB-Score。 这些结果支持从外观拟合向动作后果建模的转变，以服务于具身决策。

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) enable robots to anticipate how the visual world will evolve under candidate actions before executing them in the physical environment. By generating action-conditioned future observations, these models can serve as predictive simulators for policy learning, action evaluation, planning, and synthetic experience generation. Recent advances in large-scale video generation further provide strong appearance and dynamics priors, making it possible to construct visually realistic robot rollouts from limited embodied data Zhu et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Liao et al. (2025) .
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）使机器人能够在物理环境中执行候选动作之前，预测视觉世界在这些动作下的演变方式。 通过生成以动作为条件的未来观测结果，这些模型可以充当策略学习、动作评估、规划和合成经验生成的预测模拟器。 大规模视频生成领域的最新进展进一步提供了强大的外观和动态先验知识，使得利用有限的具身数据构建视觉逼真的机器人执行过程成为可能 Zhu et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Liao et al. (2025) 。

paragraphs.en: Existing world action models (WAMs) improve action responsiveness through numerical action tokens, learned latent codes, and spatially aligned conditions such as embodiment masks, action images, optical flow, and projected kinematic fields Zhu et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Liao et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026b) . Yet motion conditioning does not itself alter the spatial weighting of the primary RGB-generation objective. When action-responsive regions occupy only a small part of the frame, uniform token averaging can bias optimization toward static appearance. Motion-sensitive auxiliary objectives and flow-branch reweighting address related concerns Zhu et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2026b) . We further use robot kinematics to guide future-RGB supervision, aligning the model’s learning priorities with action consequences. This raises a key question: how can robot kinematics guide the learning of action consequences?
paragraphs.zh: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）通过数值动作标记、学习到的潜在编码以及空间对齐的条件（如具身化掩码、动作图像、光流和投影运动学场）来提升动作响应性 Zhu et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Liao et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026b) 。 然而，运动条件本身并不会改变生成 RGB 图像这一主要目标的空间权重分配。 当动作响应区域仅占据画面的一小部分时，均匀标记平均可能会使优化偏向静态外观。 对运动敏感的辅助目标和光流分支的重新加权解决了相关的问题 Zhu et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that action conditioning and supervision allocation serve different purposes: the former specifies what motion to generate, whereas the latter determines which prediction errors receive greater weight during training. Robot kinematics provides a geometry-derived prior for this allocation by identifying where commanded robot motion is expected to appear in the camera view, without relying on generated future frames. This suggests using kinematic transport not only as a generation condition, but also as a spatial prior for the primary video-generation objective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，动作条件设定与监督分配服务于不同目的：前者指定了需要生成的运动，而后者则决定了哪些预测误差在训练过程中应获得更高的权重。 机器人运动学通过识别指令中的机器人运动在相机视图中预期的位置，为这种分配提供了基于几何学的先验知识，且无需依赖生成的未来帧。 这表明，不仅应将运动学传输用作生成条件，还应将其作为主要视频生成目标的空间先验。

paragraphs.en: Building on this insight, we introduce K i n e W o rld , a transport-aware training framework for action-conditioned world modeling. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs camera-aligned transport, while Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates its motion support on the video latent grid and converts the resulting support into a normalized mixture distribution for the RGB flow-matching objective. The resulting objective redistributes supervision while preserving the aggregate token weight, without adding inference parameters or sampling steps. This extends kinematic priors from generation conditions to learning guidance for interaction- and decision-oriented world prediction. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) increasingly leverage pretrained video generators to connect visual prediction with robot control ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) . Existing approaches include action-conditioned video prediction ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , joint video-action generation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and action decoding from visual latent representations ( Liao et al., 2025 ) . Recent systems further broaden this paradigm. RealWonder connects physical actions to video generation through simulated RGB and flow ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while CLAP integrates heterogeneous action representations for cross-embodiment learning ( Liu & Shorinwa, 2026 ) . However, advances in generative architectures and action interfaces do not inherently prioritize interaction-critical changes in the primary RGB objective. When these changes occupy few visual tokens, uniform weighting can underemphasize their contribution. KineWorld addresses this complementary problem through kinematics-guided allocation of future-RGB supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）越来越多地利用预训练的视频生成器，将视觉预测与机器人控制联系起来（Guo 等人，2025；Liao 等人，2025）。 现有方法包括以动作为条件的视频预测（Zhu 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2025）、联合视频-动作生成（Zhou 等人，2026），以及从视觉潜在表示中解码动作（Liao 等人，2025）。 近期的系统进一步拓展了这一范式。 RealWonder 通过模拟的 RGB 和流将物理动作与视频生成联系起来（Liu 等人，2026），而 CLAP 则整合了异构的动作表示以实现跨具身学习（Liu & Shorinwa，2026）。 然而，生成架构和动作接口方面的进步本身并不会优先关注主要 RGB 目标中与交互相关的变化。 当这些变化仅占据少量视觉标记时，均匀加权可能会低估它们的贡献。 KineWorld 通过以运动学为指导的未来 RGB 监督分配策略，解决了这一互补性问题。

Recent methods align actions with the visual domain through embodiment masks ( Chen et al., 2026c ) , multi-view action videos ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) , optical flow ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , and camera-aligned kinematic fields ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond conditioning, FlowWAM reweights its flow-branch loss using reference-relative latent deviations ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , while EA-WM uses frame-difference supervision to guide cross-stream fusion ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, KineWorld uses kinematic transport to directly reweight future-RGB flow matching without introducing auxiliary objectives.

paragraphs.en: KineWorld is a latent video world model that predicts future RGB observations from the current observation, a language instruction, and a candidate action sequence. A causal video VAE represents visual states in latent space, while a conditional flow model learns their action-conditioned dynamics. When projected robot motion occupies only a small part of the video, uniform token averaging assigns this region a correspondingly small share of the total token weight. KineWorld uses commanded kinematics to guide both generation and learning: camera-aligned transport conditions the predicted motion, while its spatial support directs a fixed share of future-RGB supervision toward regions of projected robot motion. KineWorld comprises two components. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs camera-aligned transport and injects its latent representation z u z^{u} into the video generator as a clean structural condition. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) derives calibrated support d d from the transport fields and constructs normalized token weights for the flow-matching objective. KTL supplies motion conditions during both training and inference, whereas TAWD modifies only training-time supervision.

paragraphs.en: We presented KineWorld, a kinematics-guided framework for action-conditioned video prediction. KTL constructs camera-aligned transport, and TAWD calibrates its support and uses it to redistribute future-RGB supervision between action-responsive regions and the full scene. The objective preserves the total token weight and recovers uniform supervision under zero motion, without adding inference parameters or denoising steps. Trained on ALOHA–AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0 , KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results highlight the potential of kinematics-guided supervision to advance world models from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.

paragraphs.en: KineWorld may improve the action responsiveness of embodied world models by directing learning toward image regions that are causally associated with commanded robot motion. More faithful action-conditioned rollouts could support simulation, policy evaluation, and data generation while reducing unnecessary physical interaction. At the same time, generated videos remain predictions rather than certified physical trajectories: errors in calibration, contact modeling, or long-horizon generation can produce plausible but unsafe outcomes. KineWorld should therefore be used together with independent feasibility checks, collision detection, controller limits, and validation on the target robot.
paragraphs.zh: KineWorld 通过将学习引导至与指令机器人运动存在因果关联的图像区域，可能提升具身世界模型的动作响应速度。 更忠实于动作条件的模拟展开过程，可在减少不必要的物理交互的同时，支持模拟、策略评估和数据生成。 与此同时，生成的视频仍然是预测结果，而非经过验证的物理轨迹：校准、接触建模或长期生成中的错误，可能导致看似合理但实际不安全的结果。 因此，KineWorld 应与独立的可行性检查、碰撞检测、控制器限制以及对目标机器人的验证共同使用。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish action conditioning from supervision allocation. Action-induced motion can occupy only a small fraction of video-latent tokens, so uniform averaging of the RGB-generation objective can underemphasize prediction errors in action-responsive regions. paragraphs.en: We introduce KineWorld, a transport-aware embodied world-modeling framework that promotes robot kinematics from an auxiliary condition to a signal for allocating generative supervision. Given the initial embodiment configuration and commanded action sequence, KineWorld constructs camera-aligned transport support and redistributes token-wise supervision between global scene modeling and action-responsive regions while preserving the total token weight.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 KineWorld，这是一个具备运输感知的具身世界建模框架，它将机器人运动学从辅助条件提升为用于分配生成监督的信号。 在给定初始具身配置和指令动作序列后，KineWorld 会构建与摄像头对齐的运输支撑结构，并在保持总令牌权重的同时，将逐令牌的监督重新分配到全局场景建模与响应动作的区域之间。

paragraphs.en: Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) rolls out the commanded configurations, renders the embodiment from the observation camera, and estimates source-supported inter-frame transport. paragraphs.en: The three-view protocol uses synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist observations together with an initial robot state, instruction, and action sequence. paragraphs.en: We count instantiated denoiser tensor entries rather than checkpoint bytes and identify trainable parameters from the frozen continuation contract. An optional 778,125,326-parameter action expert (15.56317% of the DiT) is stored in the joint training checkpoint, but the reported single-view loader ignores it; we consequently exclude it from the active denoiser size. paragraphs.en: For motion diagnostics, we estimate dense flow between adjacent frames with Farnebäck’s two-frame method ( Farnebäck, 2003 ) . FB ​ Mean \operatorname{FB\ Mean} and FB ​ P95 \operatorname{FB\ P95} are the mean and 95th percentile of the resulting flow magnitudes, while Jerk \operatorname{Jerk} summarizes temporal variation across successive flow fields as a heuristic smoothness measure. Related differential-flow and jerk-based analyses precede this work ( Shen et al., 2020 ; Takeda et al., 2018 ) . These statistics characterize different failure modes: adjacent differences are sensitive to both motion and flicker, first-to-last difference measures endpoint change but not path quality, near-duplicate rate exposes repetition, and flow magnitude or jerk does not by itself establish correct action-conditioned motion. We therefore assign no universal optimization direction and use the diagnostics only to interpret the interpolation ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 在运动诊断中，我们使用 Farnebäck 的双帧方法（Farnebäck, 2003）来估计相邻帧之间的密集流。 FB Mean \operatorname{FB\ Mean} 和 FB P95 \operatorname{FB\ P95} 分别是所得流强度的均值和第 95 百分位数，而 Jerk \operatorname{Jerk} 则作为启发式平滑度指标，概括了连续流场之间的时间变化。 与此相关基于差分流和突变的分析早于本研究（Shen et al., 2020; Takeda et al., 2018）。 这些统计量描述了不同的故障模式：相邻差异对运动和闪烁都敏感，首尾差异衡量的是端点变化而非路径质量，近重复率能暴露重复现象，而流强度或突变本身无法确定动作条件下的正确运动。 因此，我们没有设定通用的优化方向，仅将这些诊断结果用于解释插值消融分析。

paragraphs.en: This ablation tests whether learned interpolation improves motion and visual quality over linear expansion with the generated keyframes fixed (Table A.4 and Figure A.5 ). paragraphs.en: Table A.5 compares temporal reconstruction on fixed generated outputs. paragraphs.zh: 这项诊断测试可判断插值是否改变了中间运动与帧重复，而未改变端点（表 A.6）。 RIFE 将平均光流幅度从 0.109 提升至 0.337，并将近重复对的比例从 0.588 降至 0.563，同时保留了首帧与末帧之间的差异，这证实了其性能提升源于更丰富的中间运动，而非端点漂移。

paragraphs.en: KineWorld relies on calibrated robot and camera models, and its transport support is sensitive to calibration errors, flow estimation errors, and occlusion. The support captures projected robot motion but does not explicitly model object motion or contact dynamics. Autoregressive rollout may accumulate appearance drift, while transport-focused supervision may trade visual fidelity for motion quality. The matched study evaluates TAWD over a 50-update continuation from a shared checkpoint; convergence and stability across training seeds remain to be assessed. Future work will investigate object-aware transport, calibration-robust conditioning, and cross-embodiment transfer.
paragraphs.zh: KineWorld 依赖经过校准的机器人和相机模型，其运输支持对校准误差、流估计误差和遮挡非常敏感。 该支持机制能够捕捉投影后的机器人运动，但并未显式建模物体运动或接触动力学。 自回归展开可能会累积外观漂移，而专注于运输的监督方法则可能以牺牲视觉保真度为代价来换取运动质量。 该匹配研究在一个共享检查点基础上，通过 50 次更新延续对 TAWD 进行了评估；不同训练种子下的收敛性和稳定性仍有待进一步评估。 未来的工作将研究具备物体感知能力的运输机制、对校准具有鲁棒性的条件设置，以及跨实体迁移方法。

paragraphs.en: Generated rollouts are predictive media rather than certified robot trajectories. They must not be used as evidence of collision-free or hardware-safe execution. Deployment requires independent state estimation, feasibility and collision checking, controller limits, emergency handling, and validation in the target simulator and robot system.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的展开序列是预测性媒体，而非经过认证的机器人轨迹。 它们绝不能被用作无碰撞或硬件安全执行的证据。 部署需要独立的状态估计、可行性与碰撞检查、控制器限制、应急处理，以及在目标模拟器和机器人系统中进行验证。

sents.en: Generated rollouts are predictive media rather than certified robot trajectories.
sents.zh: 生成的展开序列是预测性媒体，而非经过认证的机器人轨迹。

sents.en: They must not be used as evidence of collision-free or hardware-safe execution.
sents.zh: 它们绝不能被用作无碰撞或硬件安全执行的证据。

sents.en: Deployment requires independent state estimation, feasibility and collision checking, controller limits, emergency handling, and validation in the target simulator and robot system.
sents.zh: 部署需要独立的状态估计、可行性与碰撞检查、控制器限制、应急处理，以及在目标模拟器和机器人系统中进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Reproducing the controlled comparison requires:
paragraphs.zh: 要重现受控比较，需要：

paragraphs.en: source code for rendering, support construction, training, sampling, and evaluation;
paragraphs.zh: 用于渲染、构建支持、训练、采样和评估的源代码；

paragraphs.en: pinned environment and dependency versions, including renderer, RAFT, and VAE revisions;
paragraphs.zh: 固定的环境和依赖版本，包括渲染器、RAFT 和 VAE 的版本；

paragraphs.en: data-split and episode manifests with checksums and license notes;
paragraphs.zh: 数据分割和剧集清单包含校验和与许可说明；

paragraphs.en: parent and trained checkpoint hashes plus complete run configurations;
paragraphs.zh: 父级和训练检查点的哈希值，以及完整的运行配置；

paragraphs.en: external-source records and local or matched per-episode evaluations with bootstrap scripts;
paragraphs.zh: 外部源记录以及本地或匹配的每集评估与自助脚本；

paragraphs.en: generated-video manifests linking each output to its input, seed, and checkpoint; and
paragraphs.zh: 生成的视频清单将每个输出与其输入、种子和检查点关联起来；并且

paragraphs.en: timing, memory, seed-variation, ablation, qualitative-selection, and failure-case reports.
paragraphs.zh: 时序、记忆、种子变化、消融研究、定性选择以及失败案例报告。

paragraphs.en: The normalization and zero-motion properties follow from the objective definition. The reported system profiles and local diagnostics characterize their respective evaluation scopes; their interpretation is distinct from the causal effect of changing future-RGB supervision (Appendix A.8.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 归一化和零运动特性源于该目标定义。 所报告的系统配置文件和局部诊断结果分别描述了各自的评价范围；它们的解释与改变未来-RGB监督所带来的因果效应不同（附录 A.8.2）。
